originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: See epithelial, hybrid and more mesenchymal properties as feature combinations, without inferring an observed transition or malignancy.
originalFrozenTask.gap: The non-arrow continuum and explicit caption avoid a compulsory trajectory and are a useful existing visual. It still represents properties only as names; small cell-shape/contact/polarity sketches would make hybrid combinations concrete for a novice.
accuracyGuardrails: Show illustrative feature combinations, not a universal marker test, fixed trajectory, metastatic route or resistant-cell ranking; normal repair/development remain possible contexts.

generatorCustody: Original generator privately retained, not publicly delivered; editable SVG without an executable reproduction-package promise.
sourceDepth: Actual primary abstracts and selected primary/official passages; exact per-owner private lookup/depth/failure/custody receipts. No whole-paper/clinical/scientific approval implied.
themeMethod: Exact shared geometry and wording, palette substitutions only
